description: Native Bullet SF-binpack architecture smoke: one train-time input bucket expanded to the 32-bucket runtime layout, with 1280 hidden neurons.

metadata.previous_result: native-searchaware-rootchild-combo-w2-lr5e7-e80 failed the combined exported model gate at 1126/2090 top1 versus the required 1300/2090, so the current search-aware patching family is closed.
metadata.basis: The prior one-bucket Test79 scalar smoke was the best bucket-density signal despite still failing promotion gates. The prior 1280-hidden smoke used 16 buckets and was flat versus the 1024-hidden 16-bucket baseline. This run combines the best bucket density with the wider hidden layer.
metadata.hypothesis: A one-bucket train-time representation reduces bucket data starvation, while 1280 hidden neurons may recover capacity without adding bucket sparsity.
metadata.gate: After training, run tools/validate/checkpoint_sweep.py on the external 800-target Lichess-policy corpus for checkpoints 512,1024,1536,2048. Reject unless a checkpoint beats the reference on candidate/reference counts, capped sum, and tail regression.
metadata.decision: One architecture smoke only. No SPRT unless checkpoint sweep is clearly positive and mate-like tails are clean.

validation.checkpoint_sweep: After bullet_train completes, run tools/validate/checkpoint_sweep.py with --enyo-input-buckets 1 --enyo-runtime-input-buckets 32 --hidden 1280 --l2 16 against /home/petter/code/cpp/chess/nnue/runs/native-lichess-policy-targets-800-mc26-20260524/lichess_policy_targets.jsonl.
validation.hard_stop: No 300k follow-up and no SPRT unless the 800-target checkpoint sweep is clearly better than the reference and has no mate-like tail blowout.
